title: 小池
author: Yang Wanli

translation: the spring trickles silently, sparing its thin stream
the tree shade rests on the water, loving the soft clear light
a young lotus has just shown its pointed tip
already a dragonfly has settled on it

appreciation: Yang Wanli watches a pond so small that its details become the whole world: a whisper of water, shade on the surface, one lotus bud and a waiting dragonfly. The poem is famous for catching a single instant of early summer before it changes. Its freshness comes from giving the spring and the shade feelings of their own.
